high_level_description: The image features a close-up of a woman's neck and shoulders, showcasing an elegant piece of jewelry. The jewelry includes a necklace and matching earrings. The necklace is adorned with large, emerald-green gemstones that are rectangular in shape, set in a silver or white metal frame, which is embellished with smaller, sparkling diamonds. The earrings mirror the design of the necklace, with the same green gemstones and diamond accents. The woman has long, dark brown hair that cascades over her shoulders. Her lips are painted a bold red, adding a vibrant contrast to the green of the jewelry.
